description: This vertical bar chart illustrates the distribution of tokens across various text categories. The horizontal category axis, labeled "Categories," displays eight distinct text domains in an unsorted arrangement: Administrative, Religion, Non-fiction, Fiction, Law, News, Science, and Blogs, with the labels rotated diagonally for readability. The vertical value axis is labeled "Tokens (K)" and uses a linear scale with numeric tick marks ranging from 0 to 10,000 at regular intervals of 2,000, indicating values in thousands. Each category is represented by a single light blue bar, as the chart does not feature grouped or stacked elements. The bars are visually emphasized with dark blue numerical annotations placed directly above them, providing exact token counts for each domain. Based on these annotations, the shortest bar corresponds to the Blogs category with a value of 32, while the tallest bar represents the News category with a value of 10,584. The values for the remaining categories are Administrative at 6,472, Non-fiction at 1,889, Science at 1,626, Religion at 652, Fiction at 387, and Law at 354.
